EN: Area's secured. You may proceed.
ZH: 区域已清除。你可以通行了。

EN: Ha friends! The King makes good on his word, see?
ZH: 哈，朋友们！猫王向来说话算数，瞧见了吧？

EN: We'll protect the rear while you hunt down their Alpha.
ZH: 你们去追阿尔法，我们守住后方。

EN: Deathclaws! Time for target practice.
ZH: 死爪！打靶时间到了。

EN: We're not Deathclaws. Maybe they're malfunctioning?
ZH: 我们不是死爪。也许它们出了故障？

EN: We finally found the fiends who felled our fraternity
ZH: 吾等终寻得残害吾辈同胞之恶煞仇寇！

EN: Hey, the funny-speaking Mole rats are back. Time to finish the job.
ZH: 嘿，那些满嘴之乎者也的鼹鼠又来了。该了结这桩事了。

EN: More Mole rats… err… merit more… oh screw it. Let's just cook 'em.
ZH: 鼹鼠越来越多……呃……越……越什么来着……唉，管他呢。直接烤了它们。

EN: Revenge and reckoning! Rest in ruin!
ZH: 复仇与清算！在废墟中安息吧！

EN: Roooooaaaaaaaarrr!
ZH: 吼啊啊啊啊啊！

EN: Here's the Alpha! With the whole family!
ZH: 阿尔法来了！还带着全家老小！

EN: Ah help! The Deathclaws… They kept us here to eat us later.
ZH: 啊救命！那些死爪……它们把我们关在这儿，打算以后吃掉。

EN: Ah thank you, friend! This is a generous invitation. It's dangerous out here.
ZH: 啊谢谢你，朋友！这是个慷慨的邀请。外面太危险了。

EN: You're safe now. And anyone willing is welcome to join our vault.
ZH: 你们现在安全了。任何愿意的人都欢迎加入我们的避难所。

EN: Humans. Have we met before? My brethren have shunned me for my peaceful inclinations.
ZH: 人类。我们之前见过吗？就因为我爱好和平，同胞们都排挤我。

EN: How disappointing.
ZH: 真令人失望。

EN: Perhaps an assortment of paraphernalia from my collection would satisfy your covetousness.
ZH: 也许我收藏的各式物件能满足你的贪婪。

EN: Alas, I will not escape fate on this day.
ZH: 唉，我终究还是逃不过今天的命运。

EN: No chance! We are an eradication team. So we eradicate.
ZH: 没门儿！我们是清除队。所以我们清除。

EN: We can show mercy… for a price
ZH: 我们可以开恩……只要代价合适。

EN: Déjà vu. This time, can you die for real?
ZH: 似曾相识。这一次，你能不能真死一回？

EN: I resolved to play dead to avoid their wrath, as well as the weapons of Man.
ZH: 我决定装死来躲避它们的怒火，也躲避人类的武器。

EN: Dare I hope you'll show me mercy?
ZH: 我能否斗胆希望你们对我开恩？

EN: Deathclaw Strippers
ZH: 死爪舞娘

EN: Nabbed from Nuka-World
ZH: 从核子世界抢过来的

EN: You here to help?
ZH: 你是来帮忙的？

EN: Overseer Zilewski is that way.
ZH: 监督者扎勒斯基在那边。

EN: If you could save her, that would be just super!
ZH: 如果你们能救她，那就再好不过了！

EN: Take this - it might help!
ZH: 拿着这个，说不定有用！

EN: Well then. Have at thee!
ZH: 那好。准备受死吧！

EN: Oh! For real? So we can just, like, be friends? Works for me!
ZH: 哦！真的吗？所以我们能，就是，像朋友一样？我当然愿意！

EN: Vault-Tec? To heck with them, and to heck with you!
ZH: 避难所科技？去他们的，还有去你的！

EN: Hmm. Let me think about that... Nah. Let's fight!
ZH: 嗯……让我想想看……算了我们还是打一架吧！

EN: Looking for the Overseer? You found her!
ZH: 在找监督者？你找到了她！

EN: I'm Zilewski!
ZH: 我是扎勒斯基。

EN: Rubarb's Raiders came to me with an offer - join or die!
ZH: 鲁巴布和他的掠夺者们来找我，给我开了个条件——要么加入他们要么死！

EN: Seemed like a no-brainer. So, um, I guess now we all fight?
ZH: 这看来是明摆着的事。所以，呃，我们开打吧？

EN: Yup.
ZH: 好。

EN: Fight? No! I'm here to rescue you...
ZH: 打架？不！我来这里是为了救你的……

EN: You're a disgrace to Vault-Tec! Darned right we fight!
ZH: 你是避难所科技的耻辱！废话，我们当然要打！

EN: Tell you what. Hand over something cool, and we don't have to throw down.
ZH: 告诉你吧，还是乖乖把东西交上来，这样我们也不用大动干戈了。

EN: Looks like Rubarb is just getting started. You've received a distress call from Overseer Zilewski's Vault. Better investigate!
ZH: 看起来鲁巴布只是刚刚开始。你收到了监督者扎勒斯基的求救电话。最好去调查一下！

EN: No Rest for the Wicked
ZH: 邪恶不停歇

EN: Talk to Overseer Zilewski.
ZH: 同监督者扎勒斯基交谈。

EN: Answer Overseer Zilewski's distress call.
ZH: 回应监督者扎勒斯基的求救信号。

EN: The few that are left decided to cleanse the Nuka-Cola Plant of its Feral Ghoul infestation.
ZH: 剩下的几个人决定去清理核子可乐工厂的狂尸鬼。

EN: I'm Knight Sanducci, Maxson's Roughnecks.
ZH: 我是山杜奇骑士，“麦克森硬汉小队”的一员。

EN: Thanks for your help. Those Radscorpions chased off the rest of my team.
ZH: 谢谢你们的帮助。那些辐射蝎把我队伍里其他人都赶跑了。

EN: My pleasure. Where did the rest of your team go?
ZH: 很乐意帮忙。队伍的其他人去哪里了？

EN: Some of Maxson's Roughnecks were killed at the Wilson Atomatoys Factory, the rest retreated to the Poseidon Energy Offices. That's where I need to go.
ZH: “麦克森硬汉小队”的一些人在威尔逊原子玩具厂被杀害了。其他人撤回到了海神能源办公室。我要去那里。

EN: No Stone Unturned
ZH: 全力以赴

EN: Explore the Poseidon Energy Offices.
ZH: 探索海神能源办公室。

EN: Find the rest of Maxson's Roughnecks at the Poseidon Energy Offices.
ZH: 前往海神能源办公室，找到“麦克森硬汉小队”的其余成员。

EN: No Thanks for the Gobbler!
ZH: 对高步勒可不客气！

EN: I didn't realize he already had a home! You're one lucky owner. Here he is! Bigsby! You can come out now!
ZH: 我都不知道它已经有了一个家！你真是个幸运的主人。比格斯比在这里！你现在可以出来了。

EN: Did Brody send you? I thought we were goners!
ZH: 是布罗迪派你来的？我还以为我们死定了！

EN: We just made it inside when those Mole rats and Radscorps turned the floor into swiss cheese.
ZH: 我们刚进去，那些鼹鼠和辐射蝎就把地板啃得像瑞士奶酪一样千疮百孔。

EN: Good thing Bigsby was here. He heard them and saved my life!
ZH: 好在比格斯比还在。它听到了声音，救了我的命。

EN: I'm here to find Bigsby, and bring him home. Please say he's with you...
ZH: 我来这里是为了找比格斯比，并把它带回家。告诉我，它和你们在一起对吗？

EN: I rescued the salvage team, but Bigsby wasn't with them. One said they may have taken shelter in Vault 314.
ZH: 我救下了救援队。但比格斯比没有和他们在一起。有人说他们可能去了314号避难所。

EN: No Time for Paws
ZH: 肉爪去哪儿了

EN: Find Bigsby.
ZH: 找到比格斯比。

EN: Find Sally and Bigsby in Vault 314.
ZH: 前往314号避难所寻找莎莉和比格斯比。

EN: This sure seemed like a good idea at the time...
ZH: 这个看起来像是个不错的主意……

EN: Thanks for saving our bacon.
ZH: 谢谢你们救了我们的命。

EN: The Raiders were going to sell the Synths back to the Institute.
ZH: 掠夺者们准备把合成人卖回给学院。

EN: They're headed for the local Fallon's office. Think you can stop them?
ZH: 他们准备去当地的肥伦百货商店办公室。你们觉得能阻止他们吗？

EN: Railroad agents managed to evade capture and headed for one of their safehouses. Check in with them and make sure they're all right.
ZH: 铁路特工成功躲避了抓捕，前往了某个藏身处。和他们确认一下是否都还安全。

EN: Not-So-Safehouse
ZH: 不太安全的藏身之处

EN: Find the Railroad agents.
ZH: 找到铁路特工。

EN: Find the Railroad agents.
ZH: 找到铁路特工。

EN: We think we know where a rare Nuka-Cola Quantum is located!
ZH: 我想我们知道一瓶稀少的量子核子可乐在哪里！

EN: Nuka-Cola Quantum Run
ZH: 量子核子可乐大作战

EN: Recover the Nuka-Cola Quantum.
ZH: 追回量子核子可乐。

EN: Search for the lost Nuka-Cola Quantum.
ZH: 寻找遗失的量子核子可乐。

EN: Thank you! Here, take this, it might help.
ZH: 谢谢！拿着，这可能会有点用。

EN: Well, there's only one way through and I'm not fighting that thing. Good luck.
ZH: 只有一个出口，我可不想和那东西打架。祝你好运。

EN: Oof, sure. I guess we can handle it. Uh, stand back.
ZH: 哦，没问题。我想我们能搞定的。呃，退后。

EN: What? In there? Are you nuts? No way!
ZH: 什么？进去？你疯了吗？没门！

EN: Phew, thanks. Hey, you ever need anything, you know who to ask.
ZH: 呼，谢了。嘿，如果你需要什么，跟我讲。

EN: I might just be a squire, but having a friend in the brotherhood is worth your weight in caps.
ZH: 我可能只是个扈从，但在兄弟会里有个朋友还是很有用的。

EN: Your secret is safe with me.
ZH: 我会帮你保守秘密的。

EN: Sure, if the price is right.
ZH: 没问题，如果价钱合适的话。

EN: Don't say I didn't warn ya.
ZH: 别怪我事先没提醒你。

EN: See ya never, losers.
ZH: 再见了，失败者。

EN: Hmm, you're lucky we gotta keep this quiet. Here. Get lost.
ZH: 嗯，你很幸运我们得保守秘密。拿着，滚吧。

EN: No way! We're not letting you scumbags get away with any Brotherhood tech.
ZH: 没门！我们不会让你们这些恶棍得到任何兄弟会的科技。

EN: Alright alright, just calm down. We were never here, we didn't see anything…
ZH: 好吧好吧，冷静点。我们没来过这里，什么都没看见……

EN: No problem. As long as you share some of those whatsits with us.
ZH: 没问题。只要你跟我们分享一些那些东西。

EN: Welcome to the chapter. It's good to see outsiders in the base.
ZH: 欢迎来到兄弟会支部。很高兴看到外人来到基地。

EN: The brotherhood can be a bit closed off sometimes, but...
ZH: 兄弟会的人有时候有点儿冷冰冰的，但……

EN: I don't think we can do our job without reaching out.
ZH: 我觉得我们不能一直把自己关起来。

EN: Keep your hands to yourself and try not to get in the way.
ZH: 别乱动手动脚，也尽量别碍事。

EN: We have a lot of important work to do here.
ZH: 我们这儿挺忙的，别添乱。

EN: Hey! Have you ever tangled with a death claw?
ZH: 嘿！你打过死爪没？

EN: One of our, uh, specimens got loose and I don't know what to do.
ZH: 我们有个，呃，实验品逃跑了，我不知道该怎么办。

EN: Do you think you could take care of it?
ZH: 你能处理一下吗？

EN: Hey, uh… never seen you around… before…
ZH: 嘿，呃……以前没见过你……

EN: Name's Maximus. Uh, I'm not really supposed to be in here. If we could keep this between us, I'd appreciate it.
ZH: 我叫马克西姆斯。呃，我其实不应该在这儿，你可别告诉别人啊。

EN: Aww sweet! Can't believe we managed to sneak past the guards!
ZH: 哇哦！真不敢相信我们能偷偷溜过守卫！

EN: The Brotherhood has all the best toys, look at this! BOOM!
ZH: 兄弟会拥有最好的装备，看看这个！砰！

EN: Hey! Who are you? Get out of here if you know what's good for you!
ZH: 嘿！你是谁？识相的就给我滚出去！

EN: Hey! Nice to see a new face!
ZH: 嘿！很高兴见到新面孔！

EN: Joining the Brotherhood was the best choice I've ever made!
ZH: 我可太喜欢当兄弟会的一员了！

EN: Nothing like the smell of Power Armor and plasma vapor!
ZH: 没什么比穿上一身动力装甲，拿着等离子枪更爽了！

EN: The brotherhood has a pretty large base set up nearby. As quasi-religious orders of militants go, they're generally not awful. Maybe we should stop in and say hello.
ZH: 附近有个钢铁兄弟会的基地，虽然他们是带有宗教色彩的军事组织，但总体来说还算不错。或许我们可以去打个招呼。

EN: My Brothers' Keeper
ZH: 兄弟的守护者

EN: Learn what you can about the Brotherhood of Steel.
ZH: 了解钢铁兄弟会。

EN: Explore the Brotherhood Base.
ZH: 探索兄弟会基地。

EN: Thank you, but you've got to find my friends! I heard something about the Atomatoys Offices...
ZH: 谢谢，但你一定要找到我们的朋友！我听说了一些关于原子玩具厂办公室的消息……

EN: The Synths we were trying to help. I think they headed for the old Atomatoys Offices...
ZH: 那些我们想要帮助的合成人好像去了旧原子玩具厂办公室……

EN: Nothing, they were only after the Synths! I think they went to the old Atomatoys Offices.
ZH: 没什么，他们只是想抓合成人！我想他们去了旧原子玩具厂办公室……

EN: Androids from the Institute! They deserve better than to be dragged off to the Atomatoys Offices...
ZH: 学院里来的机器人！他们不应该被强行拉到原子玩具厂办公室……

EN: Oh, geez. I thought I was done for!
ZH: 哦，天啊。我想我已经完了！

EN: You didn't see the others, did you? They split us up!
ZH: 你没有看到其他人，是吗？他们把我们分开了！

EN: We were trying to get the Synths to safety when they took us.
ZH: 我们想把其他的合成人也转移到安全的地方，结果被他们抓住了。

EN: Relax, you're safe now.
ZH: 放心吧，你们现在安全了。

EN: Others? What others?
ZH: 其他人？什么其他人？

EN: What did the Raiders want with you?
ZH: 掠夺者们到底想从你们身上得到什么？

EN: What are Synths?
ZH: 合成人是什么？

EN: A group known as “The Railroad” was trying to sneak refugees through the area, when they were captured by Raiders. Find and rescue them before it's too late.
ZH: 一群称作是“铁路”的人试图将难民偷偷送走，结果被掠夺者们发现并抓走了。请尽快找到他们。

EN: Off the Rails
ZH: 轨道之外

EN: Rescue the kidnapped Railroad agent.
ZH: 拯救被绑架的铁路特工。

EN: Rescue a kidnapped Railroad operative.
ZH: 拯救被绑架的铁路人员。

EN: Here, maybe you should have the Quantum for safe keeping.
ZH: 拿着，这瓶量子核子可乐还是交给你保管比较好。

EN: Oh, well maybe you should have it for safe keeping.
ZH: 哦，也对，那还是交给你保管比较好。

EN: Oh, what a good idea. Here you go!
ZH: 哦，真是个好主意。给你！

EN: Of course! It's the ultimate refreshment. Here, try one.
ZH: 当然了！这可是提神醒脑的终极武器。来，试试。

EN: Oh my goodness! I'm so glad you're here!
ZH: 我的天！我真高兴你们来了！

EN: Those horrible Ghouls were trying to steal my Nuka-Cola Quantum.
ZH: 这些可怕的尸鬼想偷走我的量子核子可乐。

EN: Glad to be of service!
ZH: 很高兴能帮助你！

EN: You're crazy, lady. They were after you, not your Quantum.
ZH: 这位女士你真的疯了。它们是冲你来的，不是你的量子核子可乐。

EN: Maybe I should hang on to that Nuka-Cola Quantum so you'll be safe.
ZH: 也许我该拿着那些量子核子可乐，这样你就安全了。

EN: You care more about the Nuka-Cola Quantum than your life?
ZH: 你把量子核子可乐看得比你的生命还重要？

EN: Sierra Petrovita has been trapped by Ghouls at the local Super-Duper Mart. Rescue her before they make her their next meal.
ZH: 茜拉佩罗维塔被尸鬼们困在了当地的大无敌超市。在她变成它们下一顿饭之前赶紧救她出来。

EN: One Ghoul Customer
ZH: 一位尸鬼顾客

EN: Rescue Sierra Petrovita.
ZH: 拯救茜拉佩罗维塔。

EN: Rescue Sierra Petrovita from Ghouls.
ZH: 从尸鬼手中拯救茜拉佩罗维塔。

EN: Well, hello fellow humans! I have not seen others in some time.
ZH: 嗨，人类！我好久没见同类了。

EN: I do not enjoy being alone; say, perhaps I could join you and your people in your human home?
ZH: 我不喜欢孤独。也许我可以和你还有你的同类住在一起？

EN: I am very adept at performing various human tasks!
ZH: 我非常擅长执行各种人类任务！

EN: I can prepare delicious nutrients that we may then masticate with our slime-coated mouthparts!
ZH: 我可以准备美味的营养物质，然后我们就能用粘液覆盖的口器咀嚼！

EN: Unfortunate. I suppose I can wait for other fellow humans to take me in. Farewell!
ZH: 真不幸。我会等待其他人类收留我。再见！

EN: Wonderful! Shall I join you in your bipedal ambulations?
ZH: 太棒了！我可以和你们一起用双足前进吗？

EN: Yes! Home for humans!
ZH: 太棒了！人类的家！

EN: Ah yes! Look and learn with your seeing orbs!
ZH: 好的！快用你的眼球看一看！

EN: Human tasks?
ZH: 人类任务？

EN: Masti-what? Uh, no way, creep.
ZH: 咀嚼什么？不，离我远点，怪胎。

EN: We can always use a good cook!
ZH: 我们确实需要一个好厨子！

EN: Sure, Let's go home!
ZH: 当然，我们回家吧！

EN: We're going to look around some more first.
ZH: 我们需要再四处看看。

EN: Only Human
ZH: 唯一的人类

EN: Talk to the Normal Human
ZH: 与普通人类对话

EN: Find the lone human in the vault ruins.
ZH: 找到避难所废墟中的唯一人类。

EN: Please open your Manuals to Article 52, Subsection a.
ZH: 请打开手册第52条，第A项。

EN: “Soup dispensers must serve soup heated to exactly 200 degrees, except for gazpacho...”
ZH: “汤品机必须把汤加热到正好200度，除了西班牙凉菜汤……”

EN: Cultists sure run a tight ship. The Overseer never gave *us* any maintenance training.
ZH: 那些教徒规章制度可真严。监督者可从没给我们做过任何维护培训。

EN: Wonderful! The day we've all worked toward is close at hand!
ZH: 精彩的！我们一起努力的目标就在眼前！

EN: Thousands?! But Death is still sleeping... Hold on a minute... Get them!
ZH: 千？但“死亡”仍在沉睡……稍等……给我上！

EN: 401k, according to the Manual. The “k” stands for “kills.” You need to study more.
ZH: 401K，根据手册。“K”代表“杀死”，你需要多学习。

EN: That's... that's blasphemy! You aren't from here, are you? Get them!
ZH: 那是……那是亵渎！你不是从这儿来的吧？给我拿下他们！

EN: A team has returned!
ZH: 小队回来了！

EN: How goes the quota? How many have been killed so far to awaken Death?
ZH: 配额如何？为了唤醒“死亡”，到现在已经杀了多少人？

EN: Hundreds of Settlers and Raiders have already been killed!
ZH: 数百名定居者和掠夺者已经被杀害！

EN: Thousands of Settlers and Raiders have already been killed!
ZH: 上千名定居者和掠夺者已经被杀害！

EN: It's hard to say. What, exactly, is the quota again?
ZH: 这很难说。确切讲，配额是什么？

EN: We've discovered the truth. The Manual is wrong. The capitalization of “Death” is a typo!
ZH: 我们发现了真相。手册是错误的。“死亡”是一个拼写错误！

EN: Intruders tricked into revealing themselves? Got it.
ZH: 入侵者被骗得现了身？知道了。

EN: Thank goodness. I'm allergic to marshmallows.
ZH: 谢天谢地。我对棉花糖过敏。

EN: That's a great idea! We want to be next!
ZH: 真是个好主意。我们想成为下一个！

EN: Hahaha! A typo! That's really funny. You almost had me going there.
ZH: 哈哈哈！一个拼写错误！真有趣。我差点信了。

EN: We heard the sounds of fighting. What's going on?
ZH: 我们听到战斗的声音。发生什么了？

EN: Is it an Article 37, Subsection c?
ZH: 是第37条第c项吗？

EN: Or an Article 12, Subsection j?
ZH: 或第12条，第j项？

EN: Definitely the first one.
ZH: 绝对第一。

EN: An Article 12, but it's taken care of.
ZH: 第12条，但已经解决了。

EN: Brave Dwellers are sacrificing themselves to help meet the quota.
ZH: 勇敢的居民牺牲自己来帮助达到配额。

EN: Some refuse to accept the truth. The Manual is a lie. There is no “Death.” It's just a typo!
